For a finite reduced set $X$ of $s$ points in generic position in $\mathbb{P}^2$, write
$$s=\binom{d+1}{2}+r,\qquad 0\le r\le d,$$
where $d$ is the minimal degree of a non-zero form in the ideal $I_X$ (equivalently, $d$ is the smallest integer with $\binom{d+2}{2}>s$) and $r=s-\binom{d+1}{2}$.

A theorem of Costa (and independently of Geramita–Simis–Vasconcelos / Ulrich-type results on Rees algebras of generic height-2 ideals) gives the relation type of $I_X$ as:
$$\operatorname{rt}(X)=\begin{cases}
d, & \text{if }r=0,\\[4pt]
d+1, & \text{if }r>0,
\end{cases}$$
(at least in the non-degenerate range $d\ge 2$, which covers our case).

For $s=11$:
- $\binom{5}{2}=10\le 11<\binom{6}{2}=15$, so $d=4$.
- $r=11-\binom{5}{2}=11-10=1\neq 0$.

Hence
$$\operatorname{rt}(X)=d+1=4+1=5.$$

\boxed{5}
